Ready when you are.

Only completion is saved on this browser. Never your notes or personal details.

A small lesson. A useful new perspective.

Build an idea with three shapes

Use a small set of forms to create an intentional visual story.

01 / Explore

The idea, in practice.

Choose a circle, an arch and a line. Keep one dominant shape, one supporting shape and one small detail. Repetition creates a visual language; contrast creates a focal point.

02 / Make

A ten-minute experiment.

Create three thumbnail compositions using only a circle, an arch and a line. Change scale, not the number of elements.

03 / Reflect

A quick check-in.

What makes a small visual composition feel intentional?

A small step. A real start.

You completed the sample lesson. Keep the question, try another draft, or explore the full curriculum.
